DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。口座の記録で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with your account records?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分の二つの口座の間でお金を移しました。片方の出金ともう片方の入金を、家計でどう区別するか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分の二口座間で資金を移したので、出金と入金を家計でどう区別するか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I moved money between two accounts of my own. I would like advice on how to distinguish the withdrawal from one and the deposit into the other in my household accounts.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to distinguish the withdrawal and deposit in your household accounts after transferring money between two accounts you own. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どちらもご本人の口座ですか。外から受け取ったお金ではありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are both accounts yours? Was this not money you received from an outside source?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 両方私の口座です。片方の入金を、新しい給料として足してしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 両方とも自分の口座で、受取側の入金を新しい給与として加えてしまったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Both accounts are mine. I mistakenly added the deposit into one account as new salary income.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that both accounts are yours and you mistakenly added the receiving account's deposit as new salary income. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 口座間の移動と新しい収入を分けましょう。移した金額と日付は一致しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us distinguish transfers between accounts from new income. Do the amounts and dates match?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 金額は同じですが、表示の日付が違います。日付が違うだけで別のお金と思わず、取引を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 金額は同じだが表示日が違うため、日付の違いだけで別の資金とは判断せず取引を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The amounts match, but the displayed dates differ. I would like to check the transactions rather than assume they are separate funds just because the dates differ.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the amounts match but the displayed dates differ, so you want to check the transactions without judging them to be separate funds based only on the different dates. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 両方の記録に振替番号T-14、移動額二万円とあります。表示日が違っても、この番号を示して同じ移動か照会できます。手数料の行は移動額と分けて見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Both records show transfer reference T-14 and an amount of 20,000 yen. Even if the displayed dates differ, you can quote that reference to ask whether they are the same transfer. Let us look at the fee line separately from the transferred amount.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 手数料の行もあります。移した金額から勝手に消さず、移動分と手数料を分けて家計表に残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 手数料の行もあり、移動した金額と手数料を分けて家計表に残すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: There is a fee line too. I will not simply remove it from the transferred amount; I will keep the transfer and fee separate in my household accounts.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that there is also a fee line and that you will record the transferred amount and fee separately in your household accounts. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 照会メモに「本人の二口座間の二万円の移動、両方に振替番号T-14、表示日違い、手数料は別の行」と書きました。入金を給与とした家計表の修正と、取引の対応関係の照会を分けて進めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have written in the inquiry note: a 20,000-yen transfer between two accounts belonging to the customer; both show transfer reference T-14; different displayed dates; fee on a separate line. Let us handle correcting the household record that treated the deposit as salary separately from checking which transactions correspond.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二口座の移動を対応させ、新しい給料の欄から外します。手数料は別の支出として、表示を確認して記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二口座の移動を対応させて給与欄から外し、手数料は表示を確認して別の支出に記録すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will match the transfer between the two accounts and remove it from the new-salary field. I will check the fee description and record it as a separate expense.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will match the transfer between the two accounts, remove it from the salary field, and check the fee description before recording it as a separate expense. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。取引記録の担当へご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will direct you to the person in charge of transaction records. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。お買い物で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with your shopping?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この保存容器を買いたいです。売場に入っていた小物も一緒に買えるセットだと思ったので、内容を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 保存容器を買いたいが、中に展示された小物もセットに含まれると思ったので、内容を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to buy this storage container. I thought the small items displayed inside were included in the set, so I would like to check what it contains.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to buy the storage container but thought the small items displayed inside were included, so you want to check the set's contents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: かごの容器は見本ですか。値札の内容物の表示は見ましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is the container in your basket a display sample? Have you checked the contents listed on the price label?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 展示用とありました。中の小物は使い方を見せるためで、セットに含まれるとは書かれていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 容器は展示用で、小物は使い方の見本として入っているだけでセットに含まれるとは書いていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says it is for display. The small items inside show how to use it, and it does not say they are included in the set.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the container is a display sample and the small items only demonstrate its use, with no statement that they are included in the set. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 見本を購入品と混ぜず、販売用の商品を確認しましょう。容器はどの大きさが必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the products for sale without mixing display samples with your purchases. What size container do you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 展示の見え方で選びましたが、家の棚に入るか測ってきました。この寸法に合うものを選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 展示の印象で選んだが、家の棚を測ってきたので、その寸法に収まる容器を選びたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I chose it based on how the display looked, but I have measured my shelf at home. I would like to choose one that fits these measurements.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that although you chose it based on the display, you measured your shelf at home and want a container that fits those dimensions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 販売用の商品の寸法を比べましょう。中に入る量だけでは棚に収まるか判断できませんので、外側の寸法も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us compare the dimensions of the products for sale. Capacity alone does not tell you whether they fit on the shelf, so check the outside dimensions too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 外側の寸法を確認します。展示の小物は戻し、容器だけの未開封商品を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 外側の寸法を確認し、展示の小物を戻して容器だけの未開封商品を見たいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will check the outside dimensions. I would like to return the display items and look at an unopened product containing only the container.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the outside dimensions, return the display items, and would like to see an unopened product containing only the container. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 見本は売場でお戻しします。未開封商品の表示をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will return the sample to the sales area. Please look at the label on the unopened product.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 容器の外寸と付属品を確認して買います。展示用の小物をかごに残したまま会計へ進みません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 容器の外寸と付属品を確認し、展示の小物をかごに残したまま会計へ行かないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the container's outside dimensions and included accessories before buying it. I will not go to checkout with the display items still in my basket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the container's outside dimensions and accessories and will not go to checkout with the display items still in your basket. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。商品をご案内します。ご利用ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will show you the products. Thank you for shopping with us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。公園で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you at the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どものたこが木に引っかかりました。取ろうとして枝を引く前に、担当へ相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: たこが木に引っかかったので、糸を引く前に担当者へ相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child's kite is caught in a tree. Before pulling on a branch to retrieve it, I would like to consult the person in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that a kite is caught in a tree and you want to consult the person in charge before pulling the string. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今、糸はご自身で持っていますか。周りに通る方はいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are you holding the string now? Are there people passing nearby?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 糸を持っています。近くに通路があるので、強く引いてたこを落とすと人に当たるかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 糸を持っており、近くに通路があるので、落ちたたこが人に当たらないか心配だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am holding the string. There is a path nearby, so if I pull hard and the kite falls, it might hit someone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you are holding the string and are worried that a falling kite could hit someone because there is a path nearby. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 無理に引かず、状況を担当へ伝えましょう。お子さんはどこにいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do not forcefully pull it. Let us explain the situation to the person in charge. Where is your child?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私の横です。木へ登らせず、糸の方へ走らないよう一緒に待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 子供を隣で待たせ、木に登ったり走り回ったりしないようにすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Beside me. I will wait with my child, without letting them climb the tree or run toward the string.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will have your child wait beside you and prevent them from climbing the tree or running around. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 安全に待ち、木の位置とたこの特徴を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please wait safely and tell me where the tree is and what the kite looks like.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 案内板から見える木で、赤いたこです。長い棒を借りて自分で取るのではなく、対応方法を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 目印になる木と赤いたこを示し、自分で棒を使って取らず、担当者の対応を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is a tree visible from the information board, and the kite is red. Rather than borrowing a long pole to retrieve it myself, I would like to ask how it should be handled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Indicate the tree using a landmark and describe the red kite. Ask how the person in charge will handle it rather than retrieving it yourself with a pole. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ確認します。回収できるかを決めつけず、案内をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check with the person in charge. Please wait for instructions without assuming the kite can be recovered.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 赤いたこと木の位置を示します。子どもと離れず、糸を引いたり木へ登ったりせずに待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: たこの特徴と位置を伝え、子供と一緒に糸を引いたり木に登ったりせず待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will point out the red kite and the tree's location. I will stay with my child and wait without pulling the string or climbing the tree.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Describe the kite and its location and say you will wait with your child without pulling the string or climbing the tree. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へ連絡します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01228-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will contact the person in charge. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。列車のことで何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with the trains?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 富良野から私だけ先に帰ります。帰りの切符を家族が持っているので、自分の分を分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族より一日早く帰るため、家族が持つ切符から自分の分を受け取りたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am returning from Furano ahead of the rest of my family. They have the return tickets, so I would like to separate out mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to receive your ticket from the tickets your family is holding because you are returning a day earlier than they are. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 切符は人数分ありますか。それとも予約の画面だけを共有していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are there tickets for each person, or have you only shared a reservation screen?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家族のかばんに人数分の紙の切符があります。私は画面の写真だけ持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 人数分の紙の切符は家族のかばんにあり、自分は画面の写真しか持っていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: There are paper tickets for everyone in my family's bag. I only have a photo of the screen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the paper tickets for everyone are in your family's bag and that you only have a photo of the screen. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 写真を切符の代わりに使えると決めず、本人の分を確認しましょう。家族は近くにいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do not assume a photo can replace a ticket. Let us check your actual ticket. Is your family nearby?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 駅の外にいます。私の切符を取る前に改札へ入らず、家族に持ってきてもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族は駅の外にいるので、自分の切符を受け取るまで改札に入らず持ってきてもらうと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: They are outside the station. I will not enter the ticket gates before receiving my ticket; I will ask them to bring it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that your family is outside the station and you will ask them to bring your ticket without entering the gates until you receive it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 紙の切符で日付と区間を確認してください。ほかの方の分と取り違えないようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the date and travel section on the paper ticket. Take care not to mix it up with someone else's.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族が持ってきた券は10月4日でした。私は今日の10月3日に帰るので、明日の券は返し、自分の今日の分をもう一度探してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族が持ってきた券は10月4日だが自分は今日10月3日に帰るため返し、今日の自分の券を探してもらうと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: The ticket my family brought was for October 4. I am returning today, October 3, so I will give back tomorrow's ticket and ask them to look for mine for today again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that the ticket your family brought is for October 4 but you are returning today, October 3, so you will return it and ask them to find your ticket for today. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今渡された券は10月3日で、区間も本人の旅程と一致しています。10月4日の券は家族の方が持っています。ご本人も日付を見て確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: The ticket just handed to you is for October 3, and its route matches your itinerary. Your family is holding the October 4 ticket. Could you check the date yourself as well?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、10月3日の紙の券を受け取りました。区間も合っています。10月4日の家族の券とは分けられたので、自分の券を持って乗車の案内を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 10月3日の自分の紙の券を受け取り日付と区間が合うと確認し、家族の明日の券と分けて乗車案内を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I have received the paper ticket for October 3. Its route is correct too. Now that it is separate from my family's October 4 ticket, I will check the boarding instructions with my own ticket in hand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you have received your own paper ticket for October 3 and that its date and route are correct. Say that you will keep it separate from your family's ticket for tomorrow and check the boarding instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 券の受取と日付・区間の照合ができました。写真ではなく、受け取ったご本人の券をお持ちください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have confirmed receipt of your ticket and checked the date and travel section. Please carry the actual ticket you received rather than the photo. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。提出書類で何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with the documents you are submitting?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 書類を一枚にまとめてコピーしました。小さくなった文字でも受け付けてもらえるか、確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 提出用に二枚を一枚へ縮小コピーしたので、小さな文字でも受け付けられるか確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I copied the documents together onto one sheet. I would like to check whether they can be accepted even though the text is now small.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you reduced two pages onto one sheet for submission and want to check whether the small text can be accepted. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 提出先に、サイズや原寸の指定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does the receiving office specify a size or require original-size copies?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 原寸でとあります。紙を節約しようとして、二枚を一枚に縮めました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 指定は原寸だが紙を節約するため二枚を一枚に縮めてしまったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says original size. I reduced two sheets onto one to save paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the requirement says original size, but you reduced two sheets onto one to save paper. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この指定では原寸のコピーが必要なので、縮小した一枚では指定に合いません。数字を書き足すのではなく元の書類から用意し直しましょう。元の二枚は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: This requirement calls for original-size copies, so the one reduced sheet does not meet it. Let us prepare new copies from the original documents rather than writing in numbers. Do you still have both original sheets?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二枚ともあります。小さい数字を私が書き足すより、指定どおりにコピーし直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 元の二枚は残っており、数字を書き足すのではなく指定どおりコピーし直したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have both. Rather than write in the tiny numbers myself, I would like to make new copies according to the requirements.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you still have the two originals and want to copy them again as specified rather than write in numbers. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 指定はA4で原寸のコピー二枚、原本は本人保管ですね。ここで二枚を原寸に複写し直しました。縮小した一枚とは分けてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The requirement is two A4 sheets copied at original size, with you keeping the originals. We have recopied the two sheets at original size here and kept them separate from the reduced sheet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 原本は保管する指定です。コピーし直して原本と区別し、取り違えて預けないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 原本は保管する指定なので、コピーと分けて誤って預けないようにすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: The instructions say to keep the originals. I will separate them from the new copies so I do not mistakenly hand them over.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you are required to keep the originals, so you will separate them from the copies to avoid handing them over by mistake. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらが原寸で片面のコピー二枚です。元の二枚と並べて、下の文字や数字が欠けていないか確認してください。原本はご自身の袋へ戻せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here are two single-sided copies at original size. Please compare them with the two originals and check that the text and numbers at the bottom are not missing. You can put the originals back in your own bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 原寸の二枚で、下の文字や数字も写っています。原本は自分の袋へ戻しました。縮小版ではなくこのコピーを提出して、内容の審査は担当にお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 原寸二枚に文字と数字が写り原本は自分の袋へ戻したと確認し、縮小版でなくコピーを提出して内容審査は担当に頼むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: These are two original-size sheets, and the text and numbers at the bottom are copied too. I have put the originals back in my bag. I will submit these copies instead of the reduced version and leave review of the contents to the person in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that the text and numbers appear on the two original-size sheets and you have put the originals in your bag. Say you will submit the copies rather than the reduced version and ask the person in charge to review the contents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: サイズと二枚の準備が確認できました。原本はお手元にあり、提出するのはコピーです。担当へお持ちください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have confirmed the size and preparation of both sheets. You have the originals, and the copies are for submission. Please take them to the person in charge. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受診の予約で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with your medical appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 電話番号を変えてから案内が届きません。予約がなくなったのか、登録先から確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 電話番号を変えてから案内が届かず、予約が取り消されたのか登録情報から確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have not received any notices since changing my phone number. I would like to check the registered contact details first to find out whether my appointment was canceled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you have not received notices since changing your phone number and want to check the registered details to find out whether your appointment has been canceled. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 新しい番号は受付へ知らせましたか。予約日時はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you given reception your new number? Do you know the appointment date and time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ知らせていません。予約票の日時はわかります。連絡がないだけで取消と思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 新番号はまだ知らせていないが予約票の日時は分かり、連絡がないだけで取消しと思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not told reception yet. I know the date and time on my appointment slip. I thought it was canceled simply because I had not heard from you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not yet provided your new number but know the date and time on the appointment slip, and thought it was canceled merely because you received no contact. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 予約状況と連絡先をそれぞれ確認します。以前の番号はもう使えませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the appointment status and contact details separately. Is your old number no longer usable?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 使えません。知人がそこへ電話してもつながらなかったので、病院からも連絡できなかったかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 旧番号は使えず知人の電話もつながらなかったため、病院から連絡できなかった可能性があると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is no longer usable. An acquaintance tried calling it and could not get through, so perhaps the hospital could not reach me either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that your old number is no longer usable and an acquaintance's call did not connect, so the hospital may also have been unable to reach you. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受付記録では、旧番号へ一度連絡して不通でした。予約は現在も残っています。連絡できなかったことと、予約の取消しは別です。新しい番号を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: The reception record shows one unsuccessful call to your old number. Your appointment is still in place. Being unable to contact you and canceling an appointment are separate matters. Could you show me your new number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらが新しい番号です。不通の連絡記録があり、予約は残っているとわかりました。これからの連絡先をこの番号へ直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 新番号を示し、旧番号への不通記録はあるが予約は残っていると確認して、今後の連絡先を新番号へ直してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here is the new number. I understand that there is a record of an unsuccessful call and my appointment is still in place. Please change my contact number for future calls to this one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the new number, confirm that there is a record of an unsuccessful call to the old number but your appointment remains, and ask to update your future contact number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 新しい番号を登録しました。お手元の表示と、こちらの登録番号を照合してください。現在の予約は変更していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have registered the new number. Please compare your display with the number we have registered. I have not changed your existing appointment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 登録番号は私が見せた新番号と一致しています。予約は維持で、以前は旧番号へ一度連絡したが不通だったのですね。新しい予約は重ねて取りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 登録した新番号が手元の番号と一致し、予約維持と旧番号への一度の不通連絡を確認して新しい予約は重ねないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: The registered number matches the new one I showed you. My appointment remains, and previously you called my old number once but could not get through, correct? I will not make another overlapping appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that the registered new number matches yours, the appointment is maintained, and there was one unsuccessful call to the old number. Say you will not make a duplicate appointment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 連絡先の更新と、現在の予約の維持を確認できました。旧番号の不通記録は、新番号と分けて残しています。お大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have confirmed the updated contact number and that your current appointment is maintained. The unsuccessful call record for the old number remains separate from the new number. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなことをお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 知人の荷物を、別の人が持って行くのを見ました。頼まれたのかは知らないので、見たことを相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 知人の荷物を別の人が持って行くのを見たが、頼まれたかは不明なので見た事実を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I saw someone else carry away an acquaintance's belongings. I do not know whether they were asked to, so I would like to discuss what I saw.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe seeing someone else carry away an acquaintance's belongings, while saying it is unclear whether they were asked to do so. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どこで、いつご覧になりましたか。持ち主へは確認できましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Where and when did you see this? Have you been able to check with the owner?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 広場で少し前です。持ち主は席を外していて、まだ確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 少し前に広場で見て、持ち主は席を外しておりまだ本人に確認していないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: In the square a little while ago. The owner had stepped away, and I have not checked with them yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you saw it in the square a little while ago, the owner had stepped away, and you have not checked with the owner yet. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 見た出来事と、持ち主が許可したかを分けて説明してください。人物の顔は見ましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please distinguish what you saw happen from whether the owner authorized it. Did you see the person's face?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 後ろ姿だけです。服の色は覚えていますが、顔を見ていないので知っている人だとは言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 後ろ姿と服の色は分かるが顔を見ていないため、知っている人だとは言えないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Only their back. I remember the color of their clothes, but I did not see their face, so I cannot say it was someone I know.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you saw the person's back and remember their clothing color but cannot say you know them because you did not see their face. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 覚えている範囲を伝えてください。持って行った方向はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell us only what you remember. Do you know which direction they went?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 通路の右へ歩いたところまで見ました。その先は見えず、車で逃げたなどとは説明できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通路の右へ歩くところまで見たが、その先は見えず車で逃げたなどとは説明できないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I saw them walk to the right along the path. I could not see beyond that, so I cannot say they escaped in a car or anything like that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you saw them walk to the right along the path but could not see beyond that and cannot describe them as escaping by car. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 見えた範囲を記録します。現在の危険があればすぐ知らせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will record what you could see. Please tell us immediately if there is any current danger.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 広場、時刻、服の色、右へ歩いたことを伝えます。持ち主の許可とその先の行動は未確認です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 広場と時刻、服の色、歩いた方向を示し、持ち主の許可とその後の行動は未確認だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will report the square, the time, the clothing color, and that they walked to the right. The owner's permission and what happened beyond that are unconfirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report the square, time, clothing color and walking direction, and say that the owner's permission and subsequent actions are unconfirmed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当が持ち主を含め状況を確認します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. The person in charge will check the situation, including with the owner. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。発送のことで何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with sending something?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 相手の名前を電話で聞きました。漢字がわからないので、宛名をどう確認するか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 電話で聞いた名前の漢字が分からないため、宛名の表記を確認する方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I heard the recipient's name over the phone. I do not know the kanji, so I would like advice on how to confirm the name for the address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to confirm the written form of the recipient's name because you do not know the kanji of the name you heard over the phone. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 相手へ文字で送ってもらえますか。住所も同じ方法で確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you ask the recipient to send it in writing? Can you confirm the address the same way?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: メッセージで頼めます。同じ読みの知人の漢字を借りて書こうとしていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 相手にメッセージで尋ねられるが、同じ読みの知人の漢字を使おうとしていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can ask by message. I was about to write it using the kanji of an acquaintance whose name sounds the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you can ask the recipient by message but were about to use the kanji from an acquaintance's name with the same pronunciation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 別の方の漢字を当てはめず、ご本人の表記を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do not substitute another person's kanji; please check the recipient's own written name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 相手から届きました。私の予想とは違う字でした。郵便番号だけで住所も合っていると決めず、全部照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 届いた表記は予想と違い、郵便番号だけで住所を判断せず全文を照合すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The recipient has sent it. The characters are different from what I expected. I will not assume the address is correct just from the postal code; I will compare the entire address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the written name you received differs from what you expected and that you will compare the full address rather than judge it by the postal code alone. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お名前と住所を確認してから書いてください。宛先は本人のお住まいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please confirm the name and address before writing them. Is the destination the recipient's home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今回は勤め先で受け取るそうです。会社名と担当部署も送ってもらい、自宅宛と混ぜないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 相手は勤務先で受け取るため、会社名と部署も聞き、自宅の住所と混同しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: They say they will receive it at work this time. I will ask them to send the company name and department too so I do not mix it up with their home address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that the recipient will receive it at work, so you will ask for the company name and department and avoid mixing it up with their home address. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受取先の案内に沿って準備しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please prepare it according to the recipient's delivery instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 本人の名前、会社、部署、住所を確認して書きます。音から漢字を作った宛名は使いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人の名前、会社、部署、住所を確認して書き、読みから推測した漢字の宛名は使わないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will confirm and write the recipient's name, company, department and address. I will not use a name written with kanji I guessed from the sound.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will confirm the recipient's name, company, department and address before writing them, and will not use guessed kanji based on pronunciation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。準備ができましたら受付へお持ちください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please bring it to the counter when it is ready. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。振込みで何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with your bank transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 注文番号を付けて支払う案内があります。どの欄へ入れるのか、口座情報と分けて確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 注文番号を付ける振込案内について、口座情報とは別に入力する欄を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The payment instructions say to include an order number. I would like to check which field it goes in, separately from the account information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the transfer instructions require an order number and you want to check the entry field separately from the account information. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 案内には振込名義の前と書かれていますか。それとも口座番号ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do the instructions say before the sender's name, or do they say the account number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 名義の前とあります。私は口座番号の前に注文番号を付けそうになりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 案内は振込名義の前という指定だが、口座番号の前に注文番号を付けそうになったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: They say before the name. I nearly added the order number before the account number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the instructions specify before the sender's name, but you nearly put the order number before the account number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受取口座と振込名義は別の項目です。指定の口座番号は変えないでください。この注文の案内では、名義の先頭に注文番号を付ける指定ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The recipient account and sender name are separate fields. Do not change the specified account number. These order instructions say to add the order number at the beginning of the sender's name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 口座番号は案内どおりにします。今回の注文番号は4826で、前の注文の番号ではありません。名義の名前はヤマダタロウです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受取口座番号を変えず、今回の注文番号は4826、名義の名前はヤマダタロウで、前の注文番号ではないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will keep the account number as instructed. The number for this order is 4826, not the previous order's number. The sender name is YAMADA TARO.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will not change the recipient account number, that this order number is 4826 rather than the previous order's number, and the sender name is YAMADA TARO. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まず、振込名義の入力欄に今回の番号と名前がそろっているか確認しましょう。暗証番号やログイン情報をこちらへ読み上げる必要はありません。確認画面では、どこまで見えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: First, let us check that this order number and name are both in the sender-name entry field. You do not need to read your PIN or login information to us. How much can you see on the confirmation screen?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 入力欄には4826とヤマダタロウがあります。でも、確認画面の狭い欄では4826の後が隠れています。名前が消えたのか、表示だけが切れているのか確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 名義の入力欄には今回の番号と名前があるが確認画面では名前が隠れるため、入力の不足か表示の省略かを確かめたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The entry field contains 4826 and YAMADA TARO. But in the narrow field on the confirmation screen, everything after 4826 is hidden. I want to check whether the name has disappeared or the display is merely cut off.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that the sender-name entry field contains this order number and name, but the confirmation screen hides the name, so you want to check whether the entry is incomplete or the display is shortened. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この画面の名義を全体表示に切り替えると、4826に続いてヤマダタロウまで見えています。入力欄と一致していますね。受取口座番号の欄には、注文番号を足していないことも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: When we switch the name on this screen to full display, we can see YAMADA TARO following 4826. That matches the entry field. Please also check that you have not added the order number to the recipient account-number field.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 全体表示で今回の注文番号と名前がそろっていると確認できました。受取口座番号は元の案内のままです。金額と手数料も見て、確定前に控えの情報と照らし合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 全体表示で今回の注文番号と名前がそろい、受取口座番号も元の案内どおりだと確認し、金額と手数料を見てから確定すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: The full display confirms that this order number and my name are both there. The recipient account number remains as shown in the original instructions. I will also check the amount and fee and compare them with my reference information before confirming.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that the full display shows both this order number and name and that the recipient account number matches the original instructions. Say you will check the amount and fee before confirming. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。表示が切れていることと入力の不足を分けて確認できました。金額と受取先も確認してから、ご自身で確定操作をしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We have distinguished a truncated display from incomplete input. Please also check the amount and recipient, then carry out the confirmation operation yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。お買い物で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with your shopping?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 電話で頼んだ野菜を受け取りに来ました。同居人から追加の希望が来たので、元の注文と分けて相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 電話で注文した野菜を受け取り、店にはまだ伝えていない追加注文も相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am here to collect the vegetables I ordered by phone. My housemate has requested an addition, so I would like to discuss it separately from the original order.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you are collecting vegetables ordered by phone and would also like to discuss an additional order you have not yet told the shop about. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 元の注文を確認できる名前や記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have a name or record we can use to confirm the original order?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自分の名前で頼み、このメモに品名と数量を書きました。追加の分はまだ店へ伝えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 注文者名と品数のメモはあるが、追加の希望はまだ店に知らせていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I ordered under my own name and wrote the item names and quantities in this note. I have not told the shop about the additional items yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have the order name and a note of the items and quantities but have not yet told the shop about the additional request. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず元の内容を確認しましょう。追加したいのはどの商品ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us confirm the original order first. Which product would you like to add?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 別の野菜を一つです。似た名前だから元の品を変更した扱いにせず、追加できるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 元の注文を変更するのではなく、別の野菜を一つ追加できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: One of a different vegetable. Even though the names are similar, I do not want it treated as a change to the original item; I would like to ask whether I can add it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can add one of a different vegetable rather than change the original order. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 元の品と追加の品を分けて確認します。追加が用意できなければどうされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the original and additional items separately. What would you like to do if the extra item is unavailable?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 元の注文だけ受け取ります。代わりの野菜を勝手に選ばず、同居人へ在庫確認の結果を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 追加できない場合は元の注文だけを受け取り、別の商品を勝手に選ばず同居人に連絡すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will collect only the original order. I will not choose a replacement vegetable without asking; I will tell my housemate the result of the stock check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that if the extra item is unavailable, you will collect only the original order and contact your housemate rather than choose another item yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その希望で確認します。お受取りの際は品名と数量をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check on that basis. When collecting the order, please check the item names and quantities.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 元のメモの分を先に確認し、追加は別に頼みます。そろわなければ元だけ受け取り、同居人へ連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 元の注文を照合してから追加を依頼し、追加できなければ元の注文だけを受け取って連絡すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01229-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the original items against my note first and order the addition separately. If it is unavailable, I will collect only the original order and contact my housemate.
